items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: A young girl dancer in Catherine Dunham's show... was making her debut as a singer in the Perroquet Club. Her name was Eartha Kitt.

ctx.x: The two sisters were billed as the Peter Sisters Jr. and their mother travelled with us. Our first date was in Perpignan at the Nouveau theatre the 23rd of October. Then came Toulouse, Castre, Montpellier, Beziers, which was the last date. In Montpellier, Joyce and Edith ran into some racial trouble which I have never experienced in France. They had been booked in a different hotel from the one we were in and when they arrived and asked for their reservations, they were told that none had been made for them. Miss…

We came back to Paris the 28th of October and did different gigs the 11th of November when Don Byas and myself were engaged to open a new club called the Perroquet. A Hollywood starlet named Marsha Gayle was the directorist of the club which was at 49, rue de Ponthieu in back of the Champs Elysees. Ruddy Castel, a cuban orchestra leader played afro-cuban music while Don and I taken care of the jazz. A young girl dancer in Catherine Dunham's show, that was playing a theatre in Paris, was making her debut as a…
I did a couple of radio shows, one being broadcast to Sweden and a gig in Chalon-sur-Saône and left Paris the 28th of November for Bern, Switzerland.
